target.definition: Meta Platforms' capital expenditures including principal payments on finance leases for Q3 2026 (quarter ended September 30, 2026), as first reported in the Q3 2026 earnings press release.

inputs.name: q2_2026_capex
inputs.description: Meta's reported capex including finance lease principal payments in Q2 2026

provenance.rationale: Extrapolating Meta's 2025-2026 capex ramp (~$70-80B annualized run-rate by mid-2026)

inputs.name: qoq_growth_factor
inputs.description: Quarter-over-quarter growth factor for capex from Q2 to Q3 2026

provenance.rationale: Meta capex has grown roughly 5-15% QoQ during the AI infrastructure buildout, with some lumpiness

inputs.name: fy2026_capex_guidance_midpoint
inputs.description: Midpoint of Meta's full-year 2026 capex guidance (including finance leases) as of mid-2026

provenance.rationale: Meta's 2025 guidance was ~$60-65B; 2026 guidance likely raised to ~$65-80B given AI datacenter spend

inputs.name: h1_2026_share_of_fy
inputs.description: Share of full-year capex spent in H1 2026

provenance.rationale: Capex is typically back-half weighted as budgets ramp through the year

inputs.name: q3_share_of_h2
inputs.description: Share of H2 2026 capex falling in Q3

provenance.rationale: Q3 and Q4 are roughly balanced, with Q4 often slightly heavier

inputs.name: annual_capex_per_gpu_cluster_dollar
inputs.description: Annualized capex per dollar of AI compute cluster investment Meta is deploying (proxy scaling factor)

provenance.rationale: Placeholder scaling to relate infrastructure spend to reported capex

inputs.name: capex_intensity
inputs.description: Capex as a share of revenue for Meta in 2026

provenance.rationale: Capex intensity has risen from ~20% (2023) toward ~30-35% as AI infrastructure dominates

inputs.name: q3_share_of_year
inputs.description: Share of annual capex falling in Q3

provenance.rationale: One quarter of the year, slightly below 25% due to back-half weighting

paths.description: Allocate full-year 2026 guidance midpoint to Q3 via H1 share and Q3 share of H2
Grow Q2 2026 reported capex by the QoQ growth factor
Scale annual revenue by capex intensity, then take Q3's share of the year
